dog.description_text:
Paulie is a 1-year-old Beagle mix who weighs around 31 lbs and is equal parts sweet, smart, and cuddly. He loves being close to his people and is happiest when he gets to be part of whatever they’re doing.

He’s house-trained, does well with other dogs, and is working on feeling more comfortable when left alone and spending time in his crate. Paulie will do best with adopters who are happy to keep helping him build confidence with those skills while enjoying all the affection he has to give.

Registered adopters interested in Paulie can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
